brief:
Israeli occupation forces and illegal settlers carried out coordinated attacks across the occupied West Bank on Thursday, IMEMC News reported. The operations included abductions of Palestinians, establishment of military roadblocks, deployment of tear gas, and assaults on residents, vehicles, and agricultural areas.

The incidents occurred in multiple locations throughout the territory, reflecting an escalation of violence by both state military units and paramilitary settler groups operating in Palestinian areas.
